The Ohio $4M+ workforce funding was announced in 2026 and the American Dream Initiative expansions are planned, so neither raised a score. Community 4 vs 3 was a judgment call: scale is clearly very large, and centrality rests on the Community Manager program being embedded in the consumer bank rather than on ADI mission language. The report's 'Guiding Principles' and DOI organization statements are claims and were not scored. Supplier spend figures combine small and diverse suppliers, and the footnote says the program gives no preferences. Some evidence quotes (E2, E11) also relate to Entrepreneurship, which was not rescored here. Report quotes were each taken from a single printed line to avoid line-break mismatches.
